rules.noViewSingleStep: Omit view for a single-step form to render fields only.
rules.noViewMultiStep: Omit view for a multi-step form and validateForm writes the engine's default wizard recipe as its view (bare-controls unless createFormEngine({ defaultWizardRecipe }) names another). If that recipe is not registered, validateForm still succeeds and warns, then every step renders on a single page without chrome.
rules.oneViewPerForm: Each form has at most one view. Recipes are code-defined; forms select view.$type and pass slot config.
